# Basetica body font

R0 typography change. The user-supplied WOFF2 identifies itself as Basetica Regular, static weight 400. Copied byte-for-byte to `web/app/fonts/basetica-regular.woff2` and loaded with Next local fonts, weight 400 and swap display. Body text, navigation and inherited controls use it. Headings retain Space Grotesk; explicitly monospace prices and details retain IBM Plex Mono. Heavier body emphasis uses the browser's synthesized weight because only the regular file was supplied.

Source font SHA-256: `551daccb3801499270ed0f87170a74d750bc2c3a3c2a066812bb1b5611ff51bb`.

Checks: 124 web tests pass. Production build exits 0, including type validation, with the pre-existing dependency warning. Browser checks pass on home, raffle detail and guide at 320, 390, 768 and 1440px. Chrome reports Basetica as the rendered custom navigation font. Headings retain Space Grotesk. No horizontal overflow or page errors. Mobile and desktop pack screenshots inspected. Evidence under `artifacts/body-font/`. The initial browser assertion expected an underscore in the generated Space Grotesk family name; corrected the test to match the actual family name and reran successfully. No application repair was needed.

Local Preview refreshed. No push or deployment. No runtime dependencies added.
